bird_dog_left.cue: Keep the hips square and the back flat.
bird_dog_left.instruction: Reach the left arm forward and the other leg back.
bird_dog_left.name: Bird Dog

bird_dog_right.cue: Keep the hips square and the back flat.
bird_dog_right.instruction: Reach the right arm forward and the other leg back.
bird_dog_right.name: Bird Dog

boat.cue: Keep the chest lifted and the back long.
boat.instruction: Sit, lean back and lift both feet, shins level.
boat.name: Boat Preparation

bridge.cue: Press through the whole foot; keep the knees parallel.
bridge.instruction: Feet flat and close to the hips, lift the hips up.
bridge.name: Bridge Pose

butterfly.cue: Sit up tall before you fold at all.
butterfly.instruction: Soles of the feet together, knees falling open.
butterfly.name: Butterfly

cactus_arms.instruction: Bend both elbows to shoulder height and open the chest.
cactus_arms.name: Cactus Arms

cat.instruction: On hands and knees, round the back and drop the head.
cat.name: Cat Pose

chair.cue: Weight in the heels; lift the chest.
chair.instruction: Bend both knees and sit back, arms forward.
chair.name: Chair Pose

child_pose.cue: Arms stretched ahead, forehead down, breathe into the back.
child_pose.instruction: Kneel, sit back on your heels and fold forward.
child_pose.name: Child's Pose

cobra.cue: Keep the lift small and the neck long.
cobra.instruction: Hands under the shoulders, lift the chest gently.
cobra.name: Cobra

cow.instruction: Let the belly drop, lift the chest and tailbone.
cow.name: Cow Pose

crescent_moon_left.instruction: Arms overhead, curve gently to the left.
crescent_moon_left.name: Crescent Moon

crescent_moon_right.instruction: Arms overhead, curve gently to the right.
crescent_moon_right.name: Crescent Moon

downward_dog.cue: Long arms and back; heels reaching down.
downward_dog.instruction: Hands and feet down, lift the hips into an upside-down V.
downward_dog.name: Downward-Facing Dog

easy_seat.cue: Hands on the knees, shoulders relaxed.
easy_seat.instruction: Sit cross-legged, facing forward, spine tall.
easy_seat.name: Easy Seat

easy_seat_breath.instruction: Sit tall and let the breath slow.
easy_seat_breath.name: Seated Breathing

figure_four_left.cue: Draw the lower thigh in; keep the head down.
figure_four_left.instruction: On your back, cross the left ankle over the other knee.
figure_four_left.name: Figure Four

figure_four_right.cue: Draw the lower thigh in; keep the head down.
figure_four_right.instruction: On your back, cross the right ankle over the other knee.
figure_four_right.name: Figure Four

forward_fold.cue: Soft knees are fine; let the head hang.
forward_fold.instruction: Hinge at the hips and fold down over your legs.
forward_fold.name: Standing Forward Fold

gentle_back_reach.cue: A small lift, not a deep bend.
gentle_back_reach.instruction: Hands to your lower back and lift the chest gently.
gentle_back_reach.name: Gentle Back Reach

goddess.instruction: Feet wide and turned out, bend both knees.
goddess.name: Goddess Pose

half_lift.cue: Long spine, chest forward, gaze down.
half_lift.instruction: Hands to your shins and lengthen your back flat.
half_lift.name: Half Lift

half_moon_left.cue: Stack the top hip over the bottom one.
half_moon_left.instruction: Balance on the left leg, lift the other leg parallel.
half_moon_left.name: Half Moon

half_moon_right.cue: Stack the top hip over the bottom one.
half_moon_right.instruction: Balance on the right leg, lift the other leg parallel.
half_moon_right.name: Half Moon

half_split_left.cue: Flex the front foot; fold only as far as is comfortable.
half_split_left.instruction: Straighten the left leg, hips back over the knee.
half_split_left.name: Half Split

half_split_right.cue: Flex the front foot; fold only as far as is comfortable.
half_split_right.instruction: Straighten the right leg, hips back over the knee.
half_split_right.name: Half Split

hand_to_toe_left.cue: Stand tall rather than leaning back.
hand_to_toe_left.instruction: Stand on the left leg and lift the other knee, then extend.
hand_to_toe_left.name: Hand to Big Toe

hand_to_toe_right.cue: Stand tall rather than leaning back.
hand_to_toe_right.instruction: Stand on the right leg and lift the other knee, then extend.
hand_to_toe_right.name: Hand to Big Toe

happy_baby.cue: Keep the head and shoulders on the floor.
happy_baby.instruction: On your back, take the outer feet and open the knees wide.
happy_baby.name: Happy Baby

high_lunge_left.instruction: left foot forward, back heel lifted, arms overhead.
high_lunge_left.name: High Lunge

high_lunge_right.instruction: right foot forward, back heel lifted, arms overhead.
high_lunge_right.name: High Lunge

knees_to_chest.cue: Let the lower back soften into the floor.
knees_to_chest.instruction: On your back, hug both knees in to your chest.
knees_to_chest.name: Knees to Chest

lizard_left.cue: Stay on the hands; do not force the hips down.
lizard_left.instruction: left foot outside the hands, back knee down.
lizard_left.name: Lizard Preparation

lizard_right.cue: Stay on the hands; do not force the hips down.
lizard_right.instruction: right foot outside the hands, back knee down.
lizard_right.name: Lizard Preparation

low_lunge_left.cue: Ease forward until you feel the front of the back thigh.
low_lunge_left.instruction: left foot forward, back knee down, sink the hips.
low_lunge_left.name: Low Lunge

low_lunge_reach_left.cue: Lift the chest as the hips sink.
low_lunge_reach_left.instruction: From Low Lunge, sweep both arms overhead.
low_lunge_reach_left.name: Low Lunge with Reach

low_lunge_reach_right.cue: Lift the chest as the hips sink.
low_lunge_reach_right.instruction: From Low Lunge, sweep both arms overhead.
low_lunge_reach_right.name: Low Lunge with Reach

low_lunge_right.cue: Ease forward until you feel the front of the back thigh.
low_lunge_right.instruction: right foot forward, back knee down, sink the hips.
low_lunge_right.name: Low Lunge

mountain.cue: Weight even through both feet; shoulders soft.
mountain.instruction: Stand tall, feet under your hips, arms by your sides.
mountain.name: Mountain Pose

mountain_breath.cue: Nothing to achieve here; just breathe.
mountain_breath.instruction: Stand still and let your breath settle.
mountain_breath.name: Mountain Breath

neck_tilt_left.cue: Let the other shoulder stay heavy.
neck_tilt_left.instruction: Tip your left ear toward your left shoulder.
neck_tilt_left.name: Neck Release

neck_tilt_right.cue: Let the other shoulder stay heavy.
neck_tilt_right.instruction: Tip your right ear toward your right shoulder.
neck_tilt_right.name: Neck Release

pigeon_prep_left.cue: Keep the hips level; a folded blanket under the hip helps.
pigeon_prep_left.instruction: left shin forward across the mat, back leg long.
pigeon_prep_left.name: Pigeon Preparation

pigeon_prep_right.cue: Keep the hips level; a folded blanket under the hip helps.
pigeon_prep_right.instruction: right shin forward across the mat, back leg long.
pigeon_prep_right.name: Pigeon Preparation

plank.cue: Hips level with the shoulders, not sagging.
plank.instruction: From hands and knees, step both feet back to a straight line.
plank.name: Plank

pyramid_left.cue: Square the hips before you fold.
pyramid_left.instruction: left foot forward and straight, fold over the front leg.
pyramid_left.name: Pyramid Pose

pyramid_right.cue: Square the hips before you fold.
pyramid_right.instruction: right foot forward and straight, fold over the front leg.
pyramid_right.name: Pyramid Pose

reverse_warrior_left.cue: Keep the front knee bent as you reach.
reverse_warrior_left.instruction: From Warrior II, turn the left palm up and lean back.
reverse_warrior_left.name: Reverse Warrior

reverse_warrior_right.cue: Keep the front knee bent as you reach.
reverse_warrior_right.instruction: From Warrior II, turn the right palm up and lean back.
reverse_warrior_right.name: Reverse Warrior

savasana.cue: Nothing to hold. Let the floor take your weight.
savasana.instruction: Lie flat on your back, legs long, arms by your sides.
savasana.name: Final Relaxation

seated_forward_fold.cue: Lead with the chest, not the head.
seated_forward_fold.instruction: Legs long in front, fold forward over them.
seated_forward_fold.name: Seated Forward Fold

seated_hamstring_left.cue: Fold from the hip, not the waist.
seated_hamstring_left.instruction: left leg long, other foot to the inner thigh, fold over.
seated_hamstring_left.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch

seated_hamstring_right.cue: Fold from the hip, not the waist.
seated_hamstring_right.instruction: right leg long, other foot to the inner thigh, fold over.
seated_hamstring_right.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch

seated_side_stretch_left.instruction: Sitting tall, reach the left arm up and over.
seated_side_stretch_left.name: Seated Side Stretch

seated_side_stretch_right.instruction: Sitting tall, reach the right arm up and over.
seated_side_stretch_right.name: Seated Side Stretch

seated_twist_left.cue: Lengthen up first, then turn; keep it gentle.
seated_twist_left.instruction: Sitting tall, turn gently to the left.
seated_twist_left.name: Seated Twist

seated_twist_right.cue: Lengthen up first, then turn; keep it gentle.
seated_twist_right.instruction: Sitting tall, turn gently to the right.
seated_twist_right.name: Seated Twist

shoulder_opener.cue: Roll the shoulders back, not up.
shoulder_opener.instruction: Clasp your hands low behind you and lift the chest.
shoulder_opener.name: Shoulder Opener

side_angle_left.cue: One long line from the back foot to the top hand.
side_angle_left.instruction: left knee bent, left forearm to the thigh, top arm over.
side_angle_left.name: Extended Side Angle

side_angle_right.cue: One long line from the back foot to the top hand.
side_angle_right.instruction: right knee bent, right forearm to the thigh, top arm over.
side_angle_right.name: Extended Side Angle

side_bend_left.cue: Lengthen both sides of the waist.
side_bend_left.instruction: Reach up and lean over to the left.
side_bend_left.name: Standing Side Bend

side_bend_right.cue: Lengthen both sides of the waist.
side_bend_right.instruction: Reach up and lean over to the right.
side_bend_right.name: Standing Side Bend

side_plank_left.cue: Lift the hips; drop the bottom knee if you need to.
side_plank_left.instruction: From Plank, roll onto the left hand and stack the feet.
side_plank_left.name: Side Plank

side_plank_right.cue: Lift the hips; drop the bottom knee if you need to.
side_plank_right.instruction: From Plank, roll onto the right hand and stack the feet.
side_plank_right.name: Side Plank

sphinx.cue: Elbows under the shoulders; shoulders away from the ears.
sphinx.instruction: Lie on your front, forearms down, lift the chest.
sphinx.name: Sphinx

staff.cue: Press the backs of the knees down gently.
staff.instruction: Sit with both legs straight in front, back tall.
staff.name: Staff Pose

standing_knee_left.cue: Stand tall; squeeze the knee to the chest.
standing_knee_left.instruction: Lift the left knee and hold it in with both hands.
standing_knee_left.name: Standing Knee Hold

standing_knee_right.cue: Stand tall; squeeze the knee to the chest.
standing_knee_right.instruction: Lift the right knee and hold it in with both hands.
standing_knee_right.name: Standing Knee Hold

standing_twist_left.cue: Turn from the ribs, keep the hips facing forward.
standing_twist_left.instruction: Turn your chest to the left, arms soft.
standing_twist_left.name: Standing Twist

standing_twist_right.cue: Turn from the ribs, keep the hips facing forward.
standing_twist_right.instruction: Turn your chest to the right, arms soft.
standing_twist_right.name: Standing Twist

star.instruction: Feet wide, arms wide, stand tall.
star.name: Star Pose

supine_twist_left.cue: Arms wide in a T; turn the head the other way.
supine_twist_left.instruction: On your back, let both knees fall to the left.
supine_twist_left.name: Supine Twist

supine_twist_right.cue: Arms wide in a T; turn the head the other way.
supine_twist_right.instruction: On your back, let both knees fall to the right.
supine_twist_right.name: Supine Twist

table.cue: A flat table from the crown to the tail.
table.instruction: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back level.
table.name: Table Top

thread_needle_left.cue: Let the hips stay high over the knees.
thread_needle_left.instruction: Slide the left arm under the other, shoulder to the mat.
thread_needle_left.name: Thread the Needle

thread_needle_right.cue: Let the hips stay high over the knees.
thread_needle_right.instruction: Slide the right arm under the other, shoulder to the mat.
thread_needle_right.name: Thread the Needle

tree_heart_left.cue: Press foot and leg together; fix your gaze.
tree_heart_left.instruction: Stand on your left leg, other foot to the inner thigh.
tree_heart_left.name: Tree Pose

tree_heart_right.cue: Press foot and leg together; fix your gaze.
tree_heart_right.instruction: Stand on your right leg, other foot to the inner thigh.
tree_heart_right.name: Tree Pose

tree_overhead_left.instruction: From Tree, reach both arms overhead.
tree_overhead_left.name: Tree Pose, arms high

tree_overhead_right.instruction: From Tree, reach both arms overhead.
tree_overhead_right.name: Tree Pose, arms high

triangle_left.cue: Open the chest to the ceiling.
triangle_left.instruction: Straighten the left leg and reach down over it.
triangle_left.name: Triangle Pose

triangle_right.cue: Open the chest to the ceiling.
triangle_right.instruction: Straighten the right leg and reach down over it.
triangle_right.name: Triangle Pose

upward_salute.cue: Lift through the ribs, keep the shoulders down.
upward_salute.instruction: Sweep both arms overhead and reach up.
upward_salute.name: Upward Salute

warrior_one_left.cue: Hips facing forward; back heel down.
warrior_one_left.instruction: left foot forward, bend that knee, arms overhead.
warrior_one_left.name: Warrior I

warrior_one_right.cue: Hips facing forward; back heel down.
warrior_one_right.instruction: right foot forward, bend that knee, arms overhead.
warrior_one_right.name: Warrior I

warrior_three_left.cue: One long line from the crown to the lifted heel.
warrior_three_left.instruction: Balance on the left leg, body and back leg level.
warrior_three_left.name: Warrior III

warrior_three_right.cue: One long line from the crown to the lifted heel.
warrior_three_right.instruction: Balance on the right leg, body and back leg level.
warrior_three_right.name: Warrior III

warrior_two_left.cue: Look over your left hand; sink the hips.
warrior_two_left.instruction: Bend your left knee and open both arms wide.
warrior_two_left.name: Warrior II

warrior_two_right.cue: Look over your right hand; sink the hips.
warrior_two_right.instruction: Bend your right knee and open both arms wide.
warrior_two_right.name: Warrior II

weight_shift.cue: Feel the whole sole of each foot.
weight_shift.instruction: Shift your weight slowly from one foot to the other.
weight_shift.name: Weight Shift

wide_leg_fold.cue: Weight slightly forward into the toes.
wide_leg_fold.instruction: Feet wide, fold forward between them.
wide_leg_fold.name: Wide-Leg Forward Fold
